integrity: Finite checks are reproducible with the accompanying standalone checker; the asymptotic assertion is supported by proof rather than numerical extrapolation. Classical full-generation formulas are credited as prior work; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed prime-power q and extension degree m in the limit. Ambient algebra is a power of one finite field; no mixed-degree or matrix-factor extensions are proved. Exhaustive tests cover only small cases; historical uniqueness is not certified.
title: Finite étale generation profiles and an arithmetic compound-Poisson defect law
